events.description: Initialization of the 3D scene showing the angled medium boundary and the incoming wave dot cloud in perspective view.
events.clip_query: A 3D perspective view of a transparent blue block representing a medium and a grid of white dots representing a wave field.

events.description: Wave propagation starts, showing wavefronts moving from left to right and bending/slowing down as they cross the interface into the medium.
events.clip_query: Waves of light/opacity propagating through a dot grid and refracting at an angled boundary.

events.description: Camera smoothly rotates from the initial 3D perspective angle to a flat, overhead 2D view.
events.clip_query: The camera rotates from a tilted 3D angle to a direct top-down overhead view of the wave field.

events.description: Overhead view stabilizes, clearly demonstrating the geometric relationship of refraction (Snell's Law visual representation).
events.clip_query: A flat 2D overhead view of parallel wavefronts bending at a vertical interface boundary.
